scenarios.name: Escalating Geopolitical Tensions
scenarios.description: A major conflict in Eastern Europe or Asia disrupts global supply chains, increasing energy prices and inflation.

impacts.explanation: Higher energy costs from conflict escalation would drive up consumer prices.
Defense spending surges would increase fiscal deficits.

scenarios.reasoning: Historical patterns show conflicts often destabilize economic variables. Base rates from past crisis periods inform this likelihood.
tetlockCommandments: Break seemingly intractable problems into tractable sub-problems

scenarios.name: Strong Domestic Stimulus
scenarios.description: Congressional passage of pandemic-style infrastructure spending boosts industrial production and employment.

impacts.explanation: Direct investment in manufacturing would boost output.
Job creation in construction and tech sectors.

scenarios.reasoning: Similar stimulus packages historically correlated with 3-5% GDP growth. Current political will is moderate.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between inside and outside views

scenarios.name: Trade War Escalation
scenarios.description: US-China tariffs expand to new sectors (e.g., semiconductors), worsening trade deficit.

impacts.explanation: Reduced exports and increased import costs would widen the deficit.
Market uncertainty would drive higher yields.

scenarios.reasoning: Recent tariff rhetoric and sector-specific vulnerabilities increase this risk.
tetlockCommandments: Triage - Focus on questions where careful thinking pays off

scenarios.name: Central Bank Rate Hike Cycle
scenarios.description: Federal Reserve raises rates by 0.75% to combat persistent inflation risks.

impacts.explanation: Higher borrowing costs would slow investment.

scenarios.reasoning: Inflation at 3.46% and 10-year yield at 4.57% suggest potential Fed action. Base rates from past tightening cycles support this.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between under- and overconfidence

scenarios.name: Resilient Housing Market
scenarios.description: Strong household wealth effects and mortgage rate reductions spur housing starts.

impacts.explanation: Lower rates and pent-up demand would accelerate construction.
Home improvement spending would boost consumer expenditure.

scenarios.reasoning: Demographic trends and supply chain normalization support this scenario.
tetlockCommandments: Look for the errors behind your errors

methodology: Scenarios were generated using probabilistic reasoning based on current indicators and geopolitical risks. Weighted forecasts combine scenario impacts with assigned probabilities.
geopoliticalSummary: Rising military tensions in Eastern Europe, potential Taiwan Strait stand-off, and ongoing Ukraine conflict contribute to supply chain vulnerability.
geoeconomicSummary: Persistent goods deficit (-$77.6B) and high sovereign debt ($3.9T) create economic fragility points.
currentEventsSummary: Commodity price volatility from Middle East tensions, Fed's neutral stance on rates, and mixed retail sales growth indicate a balancing act between inflation control and growth stimulus.
